d: After dropping off some colonists in a system nearby, The crew visits a world of beautiful, healthy & tanned human looking people who seem to have a peaceful & loving lifestyle.
Onboard the U.S.S. Discovery, Ensign Tilly (Mary Wiseman) encounters an unexpected visitor in need of help. However, this unlikely pair may have more in common than meets the eye.
After waking up in an unfamiliar sickbay, Craft (Aldis Hodge) finds himself on board a deserted ship, and his only companion and hope for survival is an A.I. computer interface.
Harry Mudd (Rainn Wilson), back to his old tricks of stealing and double-dealing, finds himself in a precarious position aboard a hostile ship - just in time to try out his latest con.
Ensign Spock's (Ethan Peck) first day aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise doesn't go as planned when he and Number One (Rebecca Romijn) are unexpectedly stuck together in a turbo lift.
Newly minted Captain Lynne Lucero is excited to take command of the U.S.S.Cabot, until she meets Edward Larkin, an ornery scientist who believes he has found a revolutionary new use for tribbles.
Host Matt Mira and guests Mary Chieffo, Kenneth Mitchell, Aaron Harberts and Gretchen J. Berg discuss "Choose Your Pain".
Host Matt Mira and guest Gretchen J. Berg discuss the Discovery episode "Lethe".
Host Matt Mira and guests Anthony Rapp, Wilson Cruz, and Rainn Wilson discuss "Magic to Make the Sanest Man Go Mad".
Cyrano Jones returns, along with new tribbles that can't multiply.
The Enterprise finds missing trader and philanthropist Carter Winston, but he may not be what he appears to be.
Kirk and the crew are faced with a race of intelligent plants and a mad scientist who wants to impose peace on the galaxy.
The Enterprise goes to the center of the galaxy, where they find a race of powerful aliens who once fled Earth.

The new Starship Enterprise and its crew set out “to boldly go where no one has gone before." Their first mission is to explore the mystery surrounding the creation of the Farpoint station located on planet Deneb IV.
At the trial, "Q" continues to denounce humans, while Picard defends his race and convinces "Q" that the upcoming mission at Farpoint will be the perfect opportunity to prove his point.
The crew of the Enterprise is infected with a virus that causes them to behave as though they were intoxicated.

st: Where No Man Has Gone Before
d: Kirk's friend, Gary Mitchell, is transformed into a God-like entity.
A strange alien substance causes the crew to act out their deepest inhibitions, while the ship plummets out of orbit.

A transporter malfunction causes Captain Kirk to split into his "good" and "evil" selves, and a landing party will freeze to death if the crew is unable to find a way to merge the two Kirks back together.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: En ensom mann
d: Odo must prove his innocence when a known enemy of his is found brutally murdered in a Holosuite.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Babel
d: A deadly virus sweeps over Deep Space Nine, and it is up to Kira to find an antidote.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Fangejakt
d: O'Brien befriends the "prey" in another worldly hunting game--can he and the rest of the officers save the being from a life in captivity?
Kirk returns to the "shore leave" planet, but it's not as peaceful as it was when they last saw it.
The crew encounters Harry Mudd again, who is selling a fake love potion.
